text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: inference-queue-service - page fired (queue_backlog_high) severity=P1 region=us-east-1 queue_length=12k avg_latency=2400ms

Alex: acked on PD. seeing big backlog in the inference queue, requests piling and 503s from the frontends.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Alert acknowledged by Alex (on-call) — escalation paused.

Maria: quick dump: autoscaler HPA not increasing replicas beyond 50. HPA maxReplicas=50, currentReplicas=50, desired=120. Looks like we hit nodeQuota in the cluster.

Emma: noted customer-facing impact: several customers ingest pipelines are seeing timeouts. Support already flagged 6 customers (IDs 3xx, 4xx tokens). Need ETA for mitigation and a post-incident note. @support-sre pls start a support broadcast.

Raj: trying manual spin for now. running:

```
kubectl scale deployment inference-worker --replicas=120 -n prod-inference
# fallback: increase node pool if pods stuck Pending
```

Raj: pods are stuck Pending with reason=InsufficientCPU, scheduling can't place >50 replicas on current nodepool. AWS spot pool not giving more capacity.

deploy-bot: Deploy bot: No recent deploys in last 2 hours. Last deploy 2026-02-18 21:14 UTC.

Maria: cluster quotas: node-quotas for team 'inference' is 60 vCPUs extra; we've exhausted it. Ops request limit hit. Raising quota requires cloud-console request which takes ~20-40 mins.

Alex: can we do a short-term workaround: roll a smaller model variant to reduce CPU/RAM per replica or route low-priority traffic to degraded mode?

Emma: good call. Initiate degraded routing: drop non-SLA traffic and enable small-quantized model w/ lower concurrency. @Raj can you change the routing policy?

Raj: modifying routing config now. Pushing a canary route to divert 'free-tier' to quant-1. Quick config snippet:

```
PATCH /routing/policies/inference
{
  "match": "customer_tier == 'free'",
  "route_to": "model:quant-1",
  "priority": "low"
}
```

Raj: applied. free-tier traffic down 85% in stats. Queue length dropped to ~6.8k.

Alex: still see backlog on high-priority queue though. Any chance to evict some long-running jobs?

Maria: there's a handful of stuck prefix requests with huge KV cache warmups. I'm killing top offenders that are >30m. Doing rolling pod eviction on 5 pods.

incident-bot: incident-bot: autometrics snapshot: queue_length=6800 -> 4200 over 8m, cpu_util=98% -> 89% after routing change, 503_rate down from 6.2% -> 2.9%.

support-sre: sending customer broadcast: "We are currently mitigating an inference queue backlog in us-east-1. Some requests may experience elevated latency or timeouts. Our engineers are actively reducing load and scaling capacity. Will update in 15 mins." :email:

Emma: thanks. timeline:
- T+0: pager fired
- T+5m: routing change to quant-1 (free-tier)
- T+12m: targeted eviction of long-running jobs
- T+20m: queue reduced to ~1800, CPU headroom regained

Raj: manual scale to 90 replicas accepted by scheduler after eviction and freeing CPU. kubectl scale to 90 succeeded. ReplicaCount=90.

Maria: filed quota uplift request with cloud (INC-2026-987). ETA 28-40m. For long term need to raise nodeQuota and revise HPA to consider burst nodes.

Alex: what's the customer impact window? Support estimate?

support-sre: initial broadcast sent. customers on paid tiers mostly stable, a few had retries/timeouts but fallbacks worked. Free-tier saw most degradation. We'll join ENG postmortem.

Emma: good. please keep PD on. We'll keep this thread as the single source of truth. Add runbook tag: /runbooks/inference-queue-surge.

Raj: metrics now: queue_length=1800, avg_latency=820ms, 503_rate=0.7%.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: No further escalations. Next check-in automated in 10m.

Alex: leaving a note for followups: action items:
- increase cluster nodeQuota and HPA maxReplicas (Maria)
- add traffic-class routing guardrails (Raj)
- customer comms + postmortem (Emma & support-sre)

Maria: acknowledged, will open RFC for autoscaler policy change and nodepool config.

Emma: resolving for now? Recommend mark as mitigated but keep pager until quota uplift done.

Alex: marking mitigated in PD (not resolved). continuing to watch.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Alert status: acknowledged (Alex). Incident state: mitigated.

incident-bot: thread note: Mitigation performed: routing diversion + targeted eviction + manual scale to 90. Root cause: cluster nodeQuota exhausted; autoscaler blocked by quota ceiling. Next steps: quota increase, HPA policy change, add prewarming for KV cache heavy prefixes.

Emma: thanks team. I'll schedule a 30m blameless review in 2 days.

Alex: thanks all. :thumbsup:
